On 2026-10-01, The Hill reported “In May, state officials called off the lethal injection of Tony Carruthers, who was convicted of kidnapping and killing three people in 1994, after executioners tried and failed for over an hour to place an IV to administer pentobarbital.”; on 2026-10-02, Fox News reported “In May, Tony Carruthers, who was convicted of kidnapping and murdering three people in 1994, was not executed because officials could not find a suitable vein for an IV line, so the drugs were not administered.”.

On 2026-10-01, CBS News reported “Earlier this year, in May, the state halted the planned execution of death row inmate Tony Carruthers when officers failed to establish an IV line through which to administer his lethal injection, after trying to do so for more than an hour.”; on the same day, The Guardian reported “In May, Tennessee officials called off the lethal injection of Tony Carruthers, another convicted murderer, after failing for more than an hour to place an intravenous line into his arm.”.

On 2026-10-01, CBS News reported “Earlier this year, in May, the state halted the planned execution of death row inmate Tony Carruthers when officers failed to establish an IV line through which to administer his lethal injection, after trying to do so for more than an hour.”; on the same day, USA Today reported “Pike’s botched execution comes after Tennessee earlier this year failed to execute Tony Carruthers, who was sentenced to death for a 1994 triple murder, after execution staffer Dr. Mark Fowler was unable to place a central line into the death row prisoner.”.

On 2026-10-01, The Guardian reported “In May, Tennessee officials called off the lethal injection of Tony Carruthers, another convicted murderer, after failing for more than an hour to place an intravenous line into his arm.”; on the same day, USA Today reported “Pike’s botched execution comes after Tennessee earlier this year failed to execute Tony Carruthers, who was sentenced to death for a 1994 triple murder, after execution staffer Dr. Mark Fowler was unable to place a central line into the death row prisoner.”.
